paper_title: pVACtools: A Computational Toolkit to Identify and Visualize Cancer Neoantigens
input_type: VCF, FASTA, fusion and peptide inputs
evidence_note: Official repository active; pipeline orchestrates multiple component predictors, so it is not a single comparable scoring model.
notes: Landscape and reproducibility-profile candidate; pVACtools v6/v7 updates require version-specific treatment.

paper_title: MHCflurry 2.0: Improved Pan-Allele Prediction of MHC Class I-Presented Peptides by Incorporating Antigen Processing
evidence_note: Official repository identifies MHC-I affinity prediction; v2 paper adds processing/presentation.
notes: Pilot baseline; score is presentation/binding rather than T-cell immunogenicity.

paper_title: Deep neural networks predict class I major histocompatibility complex epitope presentation and transfer learn neoepitope immunogenicity
training_dataset: large presentation corpus plus limited immunogenicity transfer data
evidence_note: Official repository includes models and data, documents CPU inference, and is approximately 5 GB.
notes: Pilot candidate; invalid HLA names are fuzzy-matched and therefore require pre-validation.

paper_title: Improved predictions of antigen presentation and TCR recognition with MixMHCpred2.2 and PRIME2.0 reveal potent SARS-CoV-2 CD8+ T-cell epitopes
evidence_note: Official repository and Zenodo release exist; license is not expressed as an SPDX license by GitHub.
notes: Pilot candidate subject to exact license and Apple Silicon compatibility review.

paper_title: Improved predictions of antigen presentation and TCR recognition with MixMHCpred2.2 and PRIME2.0 reveal potent SARS-CoV-2 CD8+ T-cell epitopes
evidence_note: Official repository is active and describes the tool as an HLA-I ligand predictor.
notes: Possible presentation baseline; license must be documented before redistribution.

paper_title: DeepImmuno: deep learning-empowered prediction and generation of immunogenic peptides for T-cell immunity
evidence_note: Official repository documents 9-10mer support, IEDB training data, and a TESLA evaluation.
notes: Reproduction candidate; limited HLA coverage and shortcut-bias risk must be audited.

paper_title: DeepHLApan: A Deep Learning Approach for Neoantigen Prediction Considering Both HLA-Peptide Binding and Immunogenicity
evidence_note: Official repository recommends an old Docker image and otherwise lists Linux, CUDA 9, and cuDNN 7.

paper_title: High-Throughput Prediction of MHC Class I and II Neoantigens with MHCnuggets
evidence_note: Official repository describes class I and II binding prediction; GitHub API does not identify an SPDX license.
notes: Potential binding baseline after license and environment review.

paper_title: NeoPredPipe: high-throughput neoantigen prediction and recognition potential pipeline
evidence_note: Official repository states it depends on ANNOVAR and NetMHCpan.
notes: Include in reproducibility landscape; not directly comparable on a peptide-only score track.

paper_title: Vaxrank: A computational tool for designing personalized cancer vaccines
evidence_note: Official repository describes ranking of long vaccine peptides and supports multiple underlying MHC predictors.
notes: Reproducibility-profile candidate; output unit differs from peptide-HLA scoring.

paper_title: nextNEOpi: a comprehensive pipeline for computational neoantigen prediction
evidence_note: Official repository recommends containers/conda and documents substantial storage and memory requirements plus licensed components.
notes: Reproducibility-profile candidate; projected full run exceeds cheap pilot.

paper_title: Seq2Neo: A Comprehensive Pipeline for Cancer Neoantigen Immunogenicity Prediction
evidence_note: Official repository describes an end-to-end pipeline and recommends conda.
notes: Reproducibility-profile candidate; not a direct peptide-only model.

paper_title: NeoFox: annotating neoantigen candidates with neoantigen features
evidence_note: Official repository remains active and annotates supplied peptide candidates rather than calling variants.
notes: Could enter an extended ranking track if input features are available consistently.

evidence_note: Official repository states that classifiers rank neoantigens from feature matrices for 131 patients; paper metadata remains unverified.
notes: Retain as pending until a citable method and license are verified.

paper_title: NeoGuider: neoepitope prediction using advanced feature engineering
training_dataset: NCI train data and multi-cohort data
evidence_note: Paper reports evaluation on 7 cohorts, 113 patients, and 635 immunogenic candidates; official code is public.
notes: High-priority post-pilot candidate; training/evaluation overlap requires detailed audit.

paper_title: Ultrafast MHC binding prediction and immunogenicity scoring
evidence_note: Official repository advertises a separate 2026 benchmark against NetMHCpan including TESLA-608; no peer-reviewed method paper was identified.
notes: Exploratory only until method provenance and independent validation are established.

paper_title: Neoantigen Dissimilarity to the Self-Proteome Predicts Immunogenicity and Response to Immune Checkpoint Blockade
evidence_note: Official repository is available but has not been pushed since 2022 and relies on external prediction components.
notes: Reproducibility-profile candidate; output and inputs exceed core peptide-HLA track.

paper_title: CloudNeo: a cloud pipeline for identifying patient-specific tumor neoantigens
evidence_note: Official repository has not been pushed since 2019 and uses external NetMHCpan.
notes: Strong dependency-rot case for the reproducibility profile, not the score benchmark.

paper_title: NeoFuse: predicting fusion neoantigens from RNA sequencing data
evidence_note: Official repository is active and specifically addresses fusion-derived candidates.
notes: Out of core SNV MHC-I benchmark scope; retain in landscape.
